RadialArrangeOptions: Options configuring radial distribution in {@link Arrange.arrangeRadial}.
CurveArrangeOptions: Options configuring parametric curve distribution in {@link Arrange.arrangeAlongCurve}.

InstanceItem: Lightweight entity adapter representing a single instance when [[Arrange]] is in GPU mode. Bridges transform, paint, and material mutations directly to the underlying WebGPU [[Instanced]] storage buffer.

Arrange: Procedural layout container and instancing engine for Retiam. Supports both CPU scene-graph instancing and high-performance WebGPU GPU instancing (1 draw call). Takes a template [[Entity]] and replicates it `count` times, providing a rich, chainable API for 1D, 2D, 3D, radial, and parametric curve distributions.
